requirements.text: PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
2+ years of deep learning, computer vision, human robotic interaction, algorithms implementation experience
Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning
Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment
